name: Suspicious Process Initiated Network Connection
query:
event.category: network
AND (process.name: powershell.exe OR process.name: mshta.exe OR process.name: rundll32.exe OR process.name: regsvr32.exe OR process.name: wscript.exe OR process.name: cscript.exe OR process.name: cmd.exe)

name: LOLBins Making External Network Connections
query:
event.category: network
AND (process.name: mshta.exe OR process.name: rundll32.exe OR process.name: regsvr32.exe)

name: Encoded or Obfuscated PowerShell Execution
query: event.category : "process" and event.type : "start" and process.name : "powershell.exe" and (process.command_line : *encodedcommand* or process.command_line : *-enc* or process.command_line : *-e * or process.command_line : *-enco* or process.command_line: *-EncodedCommand* or process.command_line: "*FromBase64String*" or process.command_line: "*IEX*")

name: PowerShell Downloading Remote Content
query: event.category: process AND event.type: start AND process.name: powershell.exe AND (process.command_line: *Invoke-WebRequest* OR process.command_line: *IWR* OR process.command_line:  *Net.WebClient* OR process.command_line: *DownloadString*)

name: Persistence Using User-Writable Path
query:
event.category: registry
AND event.type: change
AND registry.path: *\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run*
AND (
  registry.data.strings: *\\Users\\*
  OR registry.data.strings: *\\AppData\\*
)

name: Hidden or NoProfile PowerShell Execution
query: event.category: process AND event.type: start AND process.name: powershell.exe AND (process.command_line: *-w hidden* OR process.command_line: *-nop* OR process.command_line: *-noprofile*)

name: Startup Folder Persistence Detected
query:
event.category: file
AND event.type: creation
AND file.path: *\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Start Menu\\Programs\\Startup\\*

name: Trusted Parent Masquerading
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
and process.parent.name in ("explorer.exe", "svchost.exe")
and process.name in (
  "powershell.exe",
  "cmd.exe",
  "mshta.exe",
  "rundll32.exe",
  "regsvr32.exe"
)
and process.integrity_level == "high"

name: Ghost Scheduled Task via Registry Manipulation
query:
/* Rule Name: Ghost Scheduled Task via Registry Manipulation */
sequence by host.id with maxspan=10m
  [process where
    host.os.type == "windows" and
    process.name in ("cmd.exe", "psexec.exe")
  ]
  [registry where
    host.os.type == "windows" and
    registry.path :
      "HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Schedule\\TaskCache\\Tree\\*"
  ]

name: LSASS Access Followed by Directory Modification
query:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=5m
  [process where
    host.os.type == "windows" and
    process.name in ("mimikatz.exe","powershell.exe","cmd.exe") and
    process.command_line : "*privilege::debug*"
  ]
  [any where
    event.category == "directory" and
    winlog.event_data.AttributeLDAPDisplayName == "sIDHistory"
  ]

name: CORRELATION RULE — Token Theft → SYSTEM Shell
query:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=5m
  [process where
    process.command_line : (
      "*CreateProcessFromParent*",
      "*DuplicateToken*",
      "*WinLogonToken*",
      "*GetToken*"
    )
  ]
  [process where
    user.name == "SYSTEM" and
    process.name in ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe")
  ]

name: New Windows Service Created
query:
event.category: process
AND event.type: start
AND process.name: "sc.exe"
AND process.args: "create"

name: System Information Discovery
File and Directory Discovery via Command-Line Enumeration
LSASS Dump via Known Dumping Methods
query:
process where
  host.os.type == "windows" and
  process.name in (
    "procdump.exe",
    "rundll32.exe",
    "rdrleakdiag.exe",
    "createdump.exe"
  ) and
  process.command_line : "*lsass*"

name: ICMP / DNS / SMTP Exfiltration
query:
process
where
  (
    process.name == "ping.exe"
    and process.command_line like "*-l*"
  )
  or
  (
    process.name in ("dig", "nslookup")
    and process.command_line regex "[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,}"
  )
  or
  (
    process.name in ("powershell.exe", "pwsh")
    and process.command_line like "*Send-MailMessage*"
  )

name: WinPwn / Public Token Abuse Frameworks
query:
process where
  host.os.type == "windows" and
  process.command_line : (
    "*WinPwn*",
    "*Get-WinLogonTokenSystem*",
    "*Get-System-Techniques*"
  )

name: Impossible Parent‑Child Relationship
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
and process.parent.name in (
  "services.exe",
  "lsass.exe",
  "winlogon.exe"
)
and process.name in (
  "powershell.exe",
  "pwsh.exe",
  "cmd.exe",
  "wscript.exe",
  "cscript.exe",
  "mshta.exe",
  "rundll32.exe"
)

name: Mimikatz SID Manipulation
query:
process where
  host.os.type == "windows" and
  process.name in ("mimikatz.exe","powershell.exe","cmd.exe") and
  process.command_line : (
    "*sid::add*",
    "*sid::patch*",
    "*sidhistory*"
  )

name: PowerShell Invoking Known Offensive Tooling
query:
process where
  host.os.type == "windows" and
  process.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and
  process.command_line :
    (
      "*Invoke-Mimikatz*",
      "*DumpCreds*",
      "*SharpHound*",
      "*Invoke-BloodHound*",
      "*PowerUp*",
      "*Invoke-AllChecks*",
      "*Get-GPPPassword*",
      "*Get-Keystrokes*",
      "*Invoke-ReflectivePEInjection*"
    )

name: Account & Token Privilege Escalation
query:
/*
name: Account or Token Privilege Escalation
severity: high
attack.tactic: privilege-escalation
*/

process
where event.type == "start"
  and process.name in (
    "net.exe",
    "net1.exe",
    "whoami.exe",
    "runas.exe",
    "powershell.exe",
    "pwsh"
  )

name: LOLBins Spawning Shells (GTFOBins)
query:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=2m
  [process where
    host.os.type in ("linux","macos") and
    process.name in ("awk","cpan","busybox","emacs")
  ]
  [process where
    process.name in ("bash","sh") and
    process.parent.name in ("awk","cpan","busybox","emacs")
  ]

name: Scheduled Task Created via schtasks.exe
query:
/* Rule Name: Scheduled Task Created via schtasks.exe */
sequence by host.id with maxspan=10m
  [process where
    host.os.type == "windows" and
    process.name in ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe")
  ]
  [process where
    host.os.type == "windows" and
    process.name == "schtasks.exe" and
    process.args : ("/create", "/Create")
  ]

name: Service Creation for RDP Session Control
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
  and process.name == "sc.exe"
  and process.command_line :
    ("*create*",
     "*tscon*")

name: SeDebugPrivilege Token Duplication
query:
process where
  host.os.type == "windows" and
  process.name in ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and
  process.command_line : (
    "*SeDebugPrivilege*",
    "*DuplicateToken*",
    "*Get-System -Technique Token*"
  )

name: Timer‑spawned shell execution
query:
process where
  host.os.type == "linux" and
  process.parent.name in ("systemd", "systemd-run") and
  process.name in ("sh", "bash")

name: Sudo Privilege Enumeration
query:
process where
  host.os.type in ("linux", "macos") and
  process.name == "sudo" and
  process.args in ("-l")

name: CMD Spawning LOLBins
query:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=3m
  [process where
    host.os.type == "windows" and
    process.name == "cmd.exe"
  ]
  [process where
    process.parent.name == "cmd.exe" and
    process.name in
      (
        "wordpad.exe",
        "wscript.exe",
        "cscript.exe",
        "powershell.exe",
        "mshta.exe",
        "calc.exe"
      )
  ]

name: PowerShell SSL / OpenSSL‑Style Encrypted C2
query:
process where
  process.name == "powershell.exe" and
  (
    process.command_line : "*SslStream*" or
    process.command_line : "*AuthenticateAsClient*" or
    process.command_line : "*Net.Sockets.TcpClient*"
  )

name: Registry Persistence via PowerShell
query:
event.category: registry
AND event.type: change
AND process.name: "powershell.exe"
AND registry.path: *\\Run*

name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel via DNS Tunneling
query:
dns
where process.name == "powershell.exe"
  and string_length(dns.question.name) > 50
  and dns.question.name regex "^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+\\."

name: SMB Share Mapping
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
  and (
    process.command_line : "*New-SmbMapping*"
    or process.command_line : "*NET USE*"
  )

name: Pipe‑to‑Shell (curl | bash / wget | bash)
query:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=2m
  [process where
    host.os.type in ("linux","macos") and
    process.name in ("curl","wget") and
    process.args : ("*http*")
  ]
  [process where
    process.name in ("bash","sh") and
    process.args : ("*-c*","*stdin*")
  ]

name: COM / CLSID Impersonation Abuse
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
and user.name != "SYSTEM"
and process.name in (
  "powershell.exe",
  "pwsh.exe",
  "rundll32.exe",
  "mshta.exe",
  "wmic.exe"
)
and process.command_line regex "(?i)\\{[0-9A-F]{8}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{4}-[0-9A-F]{12}\\}"

name: Linux Privilege Escalation via setcap (cap_setuid)
query:
process
where host.os.type == "linux"
  and process.name == "setcap"
  and process.args : "*cap_setuid*"

name: net localgroup enumeration
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
  and process.name in ("net.exe", "net1.exe")
  and process.command_line like "*localgroup*"

name: Scheduled Job via at
Process Lineage Inconsistencies
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
and process.parent.pid != null
and (
  process.user.name != process.parent.user.name
  or process.session_id != process.parent.session_id
)
and process.name in (
  "powershell.exe",
  "cmd.exe",
  "mshta.exe",
  "wscript.exe",
  "cscript.exe"
)

name: PowerShell group membership discovery
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
  and process.name == "powershell.exe"
  and process.command_line like "*Get-LocalGroupMember*"

name: PowerShell PPID Spoofing Tooling
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
and process.name in ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
and process.command_line :
(
  "*Start-ATHProcessUnderSpecificParent*",
  "*PPID-Spoof*",
  "*ParentId*",
  "*-ppid*",
  "*ExtendedStartupInfo*"
)

name: Credential Injection for PtH
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
  and (
    process.command_line : "*sekurlsa::pth*"
    or process.command_line : "*-Hash*"
    or process.command_line : "*-H *"
  )

name: PowerShell local group discovery
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
  and process.name == "powershell.exe"
  and process.command_line like "*Get-LocalGroup*"

name: PowerShell local account enumeration
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
  and process.name == "powershell.exe"
  and process.command_line like "*Get-LocalUser*"

name: Enumerate groups via /etc/group
query:
process
where host.os.type in ("linux", "macos")
  and process.name == "cat"
  and process.command_line like "*/etc/group*"

name: Cron Persistence via System Cron Directories
query:
/* Rule Name: Cron Persistence via System Cron Directories */
sequence by host.id with maxspan=10m
  [process where
    host.os.type in ("linux", "macos") and
    process.name in ("sh", "bash")
  ]
  [file where
    host.os.type in ("linux", "macos") and
    file.path :
      (
        "/etc/cron.daily/*",
        "/etc/cron.hourly/*",
        "/etc/cron.weekly/*",
        "/etc/cron.monthly/*",
        "/etc/cron.d/*"
      )
  ]

name: Enumerate users and groups
query:
process
where host.os.type in ("linux", "macos")
  and process.name in ("id", "groups")

name: Known Token Abuse Tools Executed
query:
process where
  host.os.type == "windows" and
  process.name in (
    "NSudoLG.exe",
    "BadPotato.exe",
    "JuicyPotato.exe"
  )

name: Privileged Write to Cron Spool Directory
query:
/* Rule Name: Privileged Write to Cron Spool Directory */
sequence by host.id with maxspan=10m
  [process where
    host.os.type == "linux" and
    process.name in ("bash", "sh") and
    user.id == "0"
  ]
  [file where
    host.os.type == "linux" and
    file.path : "/var/spool/cron/crontabs/*"
  ]

name: Windows Registry Query
Non‑Browser Process Using TLS on Port 443
query:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=5m
  [process where
    host.os.type == "windows"
    and process.name in ("powershell.exe", "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe")
    and process.parent.name not in ("explorer.exe", "services.exe")
  ]
  [network where destination.port == 443]

name: Scheduled Task Created for Persistence
query:
event.category: persistence
AND event.type: creation
AND scheduled_task.name: *

name: Enumerate user group membership
query:
process
where host.os.type in ("linux", "macos")
  and process.name in ("groups", "id")

name: Token Theft from LSASS or Winlogon
query:
process where
  host.os.type == "windows" and
  process.command_line : (
    "*Get-Process lsass*",
    "*Get-Process winlogon*",
    "*WinLogonToken*"
  )

name: Direct Access to sudoers File
query:
process where
  host.os.type in ("linux", "macos") and
  process.name == "sudo" and
  process.args : (
    "/etc/sudoers",
    "/usr/local/etc/sudoers"
  )

name: Named Pipe Impersonation via PowerShell
query:
process where
  host.os.type == "windows" and
  process.name in ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and
  process.command_line : (
    "*Get-System*",
    "*NamedPipe*",
    "*Impersonate*"
  )

name: RDP Session Hijack Attempt
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
  and process.name in ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe")
  and process.command_line : "*tscon*"

name: Suricata and Elastic Defend Network Correlation
description: This detection correlates Suricata alerts with Elastic Defend network events to identify the source process performing the network activity.
query:
sequence by source.port, source.ip, destination.ip with maxspan=1m
 [network where event.dataset == "suricata.eve" and event.kind == "alert" and event.severity != 3 and source.ip != null and destination.ip != null]
 [network where event.module == "endpoint" and event.action in ("disconnect_received", "connection_attempted")]

name: Injection & Living‑off‑the‑Land Execution
query:
process
where event.type == "start" and
  user.name != "SYSTEM" and 
  process.name in (
    "rundll32.exe",
    "regsvr32.exe",
    "mshta.exe",
    "installutil.exe",
    "wmic.exe",
    "msbuild.exe",
    "svchost.exe",
    "dllhost.exe"
  )

name: Credential Injection for PtH
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
  and (
    process.command_line : "*sekurlsa::pth*"
    or process.command_line : "*-Hash*"
    or process.command_line : "*-H *"
  )

name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel (HTTP POST)
query:
network
where event.type == "connection"
  and process.name == "powershell.exe"
  and network.direction == "outgoing"
  and network.protocol in ("http", "https")
  and process.command_line : "*Invoke-WebRequest*"
  and process.command_line : "*POST*"

name: PowerShell Download Cradle / In-Memory Execution
query:
process where
  host.os.type == "windows" and
  process.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and
  (
    process.command_line :
      (
        "*IEX*",
        "*Invoke-Expression*",
        "*DownloadString*",
        "*Net.WebClient*",
        "*Invoke-WebRequest*",
        "*iwr *",
        "*MsXml2.ServerXmlHttp*",
        "*ServerXmlHttp*"
      )
    and
    process.command_line :
      (
        "*http*",
        "*https*",
        "*.ps1*"
      )
  )

name: Cross-Platform Process Discovery
query:
process
where
(
  /* Windows native discovery */
  host.os.type == "windows" and
  user.name != "SYSTEM" and
  (
    process.name in ("tasklist.exe", "wmic.exe", "taskmgr.exe")
    or
    (
      process.name == "powershell.exe" and
      process.command_line like "*Get-Process*"
    )
    or
    (
      process.name == "cmd.exe" and
      process.command_line like "*tasklist*"
    )
  )
)
or
(
  /* Linux & macOS discovery */
  host.os.type in ("linux", "macos") and
  user.name != "root" and
  process.name == "ps"
)
or
(
  /* High-risk process enumeration tools */
  process.name in ("ProcessHacker.exe", "PChunter64.exe")
)

name: Remote Scheduled Task Creation via schtasks
query:
/* Rule Name: Remote Scheduled Task Creation via schtasks */
sequence by host.id with maxspan=10m
  [process where
    host.os.type == "windows" and
    process.name == "cmd.exe"
  ]
  [process where
    host.os.type == "windows" and
    process.name == "schtasks.exe" and
    process.args : ("/S", "/RU", "/RP")
  ]

name: Persistence via Registry Run Key
query:
event.category: registry
AND event.type: change
AND registry.path: *\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run*

name: Suspicious RDP Lateral Movement
query:
sequence by host.id, user.name with maxspan=10m
  [authentication
    where event.action == "logged-in"
      and winlog.event_data.LogonType == "10"
  ]
  [process
    where process.name == "mstsc.exe"
  ]

name: PowerShell Spawning LOLBins (mshta / cmd)
query:
process where
  host.os.type == "windows" and
  process.parent.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and
  process.name :
    (
      "mshta.exe",
      "cmd.exe",
      "wscript.exe",
      "cscript.exe"
    )

name: Enumerate Administrators group
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
  and process.name in ("net.exe", "net1.exe")
  and process.command_line like "*Administrators*"

name: UAC Registry Hijack
query:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=5m
  [registry where
    registry.path : (
      "HKCU\\Software\\Classes\\mscfile\\shell\\open\\command*",
      "HKCU\\Software\\Classes\\ms-settings\\shell\\open\\command*",
      "HKCU\\Software\\Classes\\Folder\\shell\\open\\command*",
      "HKCU\\Software\\Classes\\AppX*\\Shell\\open\\command*"
    )
  ]
  [process where
    process.name in (
      "fodhelper.exe",
      "eventvwr.exe",
      "sdclt.exe",
      "computerdefaults.exe",
      "wsreset.exe"
    )
  ]

name: SYSTEM Process Spawned from Non-SYSTEM Parent
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
and user.name == "SYSTEM"
and process.name in ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe")
and not process.parent.name in (
  "services.exe",
  "svchost.exe",
  "wininit.exe",
  "taskeng.exe"
)

name: LSASS Dump File Creation
query:
file where
  host.os.type == "windows" and
  file.extension == "dmp" and
  file.path : (
    "*\\Temp\\*",
    "*\\Windows\\Temp\\*",
    "*\\SilentProcessExit\\*"
  ) and
  file.name : "*lsass*"

name: SMB Admin Share Access
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
  and process.name in ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe")
  and process.command_line :
    ("\\\\*\\ADMIN$",
     "\\\\*\\C$",
     "\\\\*\\IPC$")

name: Enumerate all local accounts via net user
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
  and process.name in ("net.exe", "net1.exe")
  and process.command_line like "* user*"

name: Artifact and Indicator Removal on Host
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
  and process.name in (
    "powershell.exe",
    "pwsh.exe",
    "cmd.exe",
    "wevtutil.exe",
    "vssadmin.exe",
    "wbadmin.exe",
    "fsutil.exe"
  )
  and (
    process.command_line regex "(?i)wevtutil\\s+cl"
    or process.command_line regex "(?i)vssadmin\\s+delete"
    or process.command_line regex "(?i)wbadmin\\s+delete"
    or process.command_line regex "(?i)Clear-EventLog"
    or process.command_line regex "(?i)del\\s+.*\\.(log|evtx)"
  )

name: RDP Configuration & Persistence Tampering
query:
registry
where registry.path :
  "HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Terminal Server\\WinStations\\RDP-Tcp\\*"
  and registry.value in ("PortNumber", "UserAuthentication")

name: User Crontab Modification via Shell
WinRM Remote Execution
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
  and process.name == "powershell.exe"
  and process.command_line :
    ("*Invoke-Command*",
     "*-ComputerName*",
     "*New-PSSession*")

name: Credential Extraction
query:
process where
  host.os.type == "windows" and
  process.command_line : (
    "*sekurlsa*",
    "*logonpasswords*",
    "*Invoke-Mimikatz*",
    "*pypykatz*"
  )

name: Linux/macOS SetUID or SetGID Permission Modification
query:
process
where host.os.type in ("linux", "macos")
  and process.name in ("chmod", "chown")
  and process.args :
    (
      "*u+s*",
      "*g+s*",
      "*u+xs*",
      "*g+xs*"
    )

name: WMIObject local group discovery
query:
process
where host.os.type == "windows"
  and process.name == "powershell.exe"
  and process.command_line like "*Win32_Group*"

name: Scheduled Task Executing Encoded PowerShell from Registry
query:
/* Rule Name: Scheduled Task Executing Encoded PowerShell from Registry */
sequence by host.id with maxspan=10m
  [registry where
    host.os.type == "windows" and
    registry.path :
      "HKCU\\Software\\*"
  ]
  [process where
    host.os.type == "windows" and
    process.name == "schtasks.exe"
  ]

name: Scheduled Task Created from XML Definition
Network Service Discovery and Port Scanning
query:
process
where
(
  /* Linux / macOS port scanning and service discovery */
  host.os.type in ("linux", "macos") and
  (
    process.name in ("nmap", "nc", "netcat", "telnet", "smbstatus")
    or
    process.command_line like "*/dev/tcp/*"
    or
    process.command_line like "*-sS*"
    or
    process.command_line like "*-sV*"
    or
    process.command_line like "*-p*"
  )
)
or
(
  /* Windows native and PowerShell-based scanning */
  host.os.type == "windows" and
  (
    process.name == "nmap.exe"
    or
    process.command_line like "*Get-Service*Remote Desktop*"
    or
    process.command_line like "*Net.Sockets.TcpClient*"
    or
    process.command_line like "*ConnectAsync*"
  )
)
or
(
  /* Scripting-based scanners */
  process.name in ("python.exe", "python3") and
  process.command_line like "*scan*"
)
or
(
  /* WinPwn and PowerSploit-based service discovery */
  host.os.type == "windows" and
